key_events: Born under a Blue Moon, moments before my twin, Lian.
I was blessed with a sharp mind, while his was left simple and quiet, like an echo.
I am consumed by guilt, believing I am the cause of his condition.
I have dedicated my entire life to research and just discovered a potential cure: the Mindbloom Petal.
I believe this petal, linked to the same Blue Moon, is the only way to restore the balance I broke.
